challenge: Victoria Crater steep rim climb through a loose boulder field

challenge_spec.title: Victoria Crater steep rim climb through a loose boulder field
assumptions: Terrain: real elevation data, Victoria Crater (Opportunity), Mars (U01 uncontrolled) (80 m square, 5.3 m of relief, typical slope 9.5°). Credit: NASA/JPL-Caltech/University of Arizona HiRISE DTM.
Gravity set to 3.71 m/s² for mars.
Friction set to 0.7 for a regolith surface.
Loose regolith friction is set to 0.50 (calibration range 0.45–0.65); 24 path rocks are 0.30 m high (calibration range 0.15–0.35 m).

verification.message: Nimble Four-Wheel Rover reaches the goal 5 of 5 times (passes 5/5 (95% CI 57–100%)).
